name: Adaptable
body:
Aura moderate evocation; CL 6th; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Weapon Focus (with weapon being crafted); Price +1 bonus.

DESCRIPTION

This weapon functions as if it were the chosen weapon for the purposes of special abilities and feats. For example if you were using an adaptable dagger and you had the Weapon Focus (longsword) feat, you would gain the feat’s benefits when using the adaptable dagger.
